content.what_it_is: Commented (tutorial) MATLAB version of mk_depth.m for the FUNWAVE-TVD vessel_island_beach case; same algorithm with explanatory comments and a figure-window setup added. Grid: 500x500 at dx=dy=2.0, centered (L5-L13); 5x5-inch figure (L16-L19). Bathymetry ('circular moat', comment L31): base 10.0 (L29), beach ring dep=10.0-(r-R1)*Slope outside R1=450 (L35-L37), island dep=10.0-(R2-r)*Slope_is inside R2=100 (L38-L40), slopes 0.24 (L23, L26), land capped at -2.0 with the note that negative numbers are land (L45-L47). Vessel track: start radius Rs=R2-40.0, x0=Rs, y0=0.0, speed0=10.0 (L50-L55), t=[0:300] (L58), initial state (L61-L63), target radius Rship=250 (L66), spin-up t0=50 (L69); per step (L72-L95) linear radius ramp then constant (L75-L81), omega=speed0/Rship (L84), angle=t*omega (L87), Cartesian positions (L90-L91), finite-difference 'corrected speed' actsp (L94). Plots -dep with the track overlay (L98-L101), assembles vessel columns (t, xship+m/2*dx, yship+n/2*dy) with the actsp column commented out (L103-L108), and saves depth.txt and vessel_0001 (L111-L112).
entities: script (no function declaration; top-level MATLAB script)
j, i — grid loop indices (L32, L33)
xship, yship — vessel track coordinates (L61-L62, L90-L91)

equations.ref: capping land elevation at -2 m depth
actual vessel speed by finite difference

io.name: pcolor of -dep with vessel track overlay

verbatim_spans.text: % Note: negative number correspond to land
% Shifting positions by half a grid space

unresolved: The comment 'Shifting positions by half a grid space' (L105) is wrong: +m/2*dx shifts by half the domain width (500 m), not half a grid cell.

Same spin-up inconsistency as the siblings: omega uses Rship while rship<Rship for t<t0 (L75-L87), so actual speed (actsp, L94) is below speed0 during spin-up; actsp output stays commented out (L108).
The 'corrected speed' comment at L93 labels actsp, but the value is never used downstream.
Comment 'Fixing land height to be 2m max' (L45) and the moat/island geometry values are asserted; agreement with the case input.txt is not verifiable from this file.
